article: 秀丸grepをフォルダーの右クリックメニューに追加する（ユーザー単位）
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations, bundled CP932 registry files and command values, metadata, local asset links, and official documentation.
findings: Removed duplicate future date; retained 2024-04-03 and recorded lastmod 2026-11-24.
Replaced duplicated machine-wide entries and wildcard all-files Open command with two current-user folder-only entries under HKCU\Software\Classes.
Added a paired removal file, executable-path review and backup guidance, and Windows 11 legacy-menu information.
Clarified Windows 10 support ended on 2025-10-14 and added official references.
Updated safety notes in all twelve translations.
Documented that the paired removal file deletes only the new per-user keys; users who imported the earlier machine-wide file must inspect and remove those old keys separately.

post/エクスプローラーの右クリックメニューに秀丸エディタgrepを追加する/.source: post/エクスプローラーの右クリックメニューに秀丸エディタgrepを追加する/index.md
post/エクスプローラーの右クリックメニューに秀丸エディタgrepを追加する/.summary: Compared the complete Japanese article and twelve translations with Hidemaru command-line documentation and Microsoft registry backup, Explorer context-menu, reg-import, and Windows 10 lifecycle guidance. Replaced broad machine-wide/all-files registry entries with reversible per-user folder-only entries and clarified path checks, backups, Windows 11 menu placement, and Windows 10 support status.

meaning.note: Compared the full setup instructions and aligned scope to current-user folder context menus, executable-path verification, backup, Windows 11 menu location, and removal steps.

terminology.note: Checked HKEY_CURRENT_USER, registry import/export, Hidemaru grep startup options, Explorer folder/background menu terms, and Windows 11 legacy-menu wording.

code.note: Audited bundled CP932 registry file; limited it to two current-user folder grep verbs, quoted executable and folder paths, removed machine-wide duplicates and wildcard all-file association, and added a paired removal file.

links.note: Added official Hidemaru startup options and Microsoft registry backup, Explorer context-menu, reg import, and Windows 10 end-of-support references.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The registry file assumes C:\Program Files (x86)\Hidemaru\Hidemaru.exe; readers must inspect and change the path if their installation differs.

The removal file deletes only the two new per-user entries and does not remove an older machine-wide registration. Readers who imported the previous file must inspect and remove its old keys separately. Registry and context-menu behavior can vary by Windows build or policy; export existing matching keys before import.
